summary: Full backend + frontend E2E for DocuAnalytics AI. 19/19 pytest backend tests pass (session, analyze real invoice PNG, credit exhaustion 402, chat ownership 403, 6 Stripe packages checkout returns cs_ + checkout.stripe.com URLs, invalid package/origin_url 400, payments/status pending, crypto info + order). Frontend E2E: landing loads with credits=3, all chips + upload-zone + analyze-btn present, pricing modal opens with all 6 stripe buy buttons, buy-pro POST /api/payments/checkout succeeds and browser navigates to checkout.stripe.com, crypto tab shows BTC + USDT addresses/QR/toggles, crypto-order-btn creates awaiting_payment order, real invoice upload analyzed (11 structured fields, correct IVA quadrature audit), credits decrement 3->2, chat copilot answers in Italian ('Il totale della fattura è 2440.00.'), export-csv and export-json present.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> - originates from dev-tool editor source-map overlay injecting spans into <option> elements in the crypto-pkg <select>. Not a runtime bug (dropdown works). Consider suppressing in prod build.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: analyze() mime guard allows any 'image/*' including image/gif/bmp/svg - spec says PDF/JPG/PNG/WEBP. Minor.
server.py: /api/crypto/info exposes BTC/USDT env addresses to any unauthenticated caller - by design but log/rate-limit would help.
App.js: PricingModal loads /api/crypto/info on every open; consider caching. Minor.
No CSRF on POST endpoints; acceptable given anonymous UUID model but noteworthy.
seed_data_creation: Generated synthetic Italian invoice PNG at runtime (PIL) with real fattura fields: numero, data, P.IVA, IBAN, imponibile 2000, IVA 22% 440, totale 2440. Used for both backend and frontend analyze tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 Stripe package IDs verified to return real cs_test_ sessions on the connected account (Managed Payments enabled, no payment_method_types needed). Chat ownership 403 works. mime/size guards enforced. Payment status polling correctly returns 'pending' for unpaid sessions. Crypto is manual settlement (no auto-credit). If retesting frontend checkout, block navigation to https://checkout.stripe.com/** via page.route to keep the browser on the app.
rca of the issue: No bugs found; all tested flows work.
